reversals.title: Helper transfers
reversals.intro: Money sent to the helper for this booking. Finance can take part or all of it back when a case calls for it, for example after a lost chargeback or a refund that followed the transfer.
reversals.none: Nothing has been transferred to the helper yet.
reversals.historyFailed: {amount} not taken back ({name}, {date}): Stripe couldn't. Recover it by hand.
reversals.needsCase: Taking money back needs a case on this booking. Open one first.
reversals.dialogTitle: Take money back from the helper
reversals.dialogDescription: Stripe takes it from the helper's balance. If they've already been paid out to their bank, it can't, and you'll recover it by hand.
reversals.amountTooHigh: At most {amount} is left to take back.
reversals.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log. At least 10 characters.
reversals.reasonRequired: Write why, in at least 10 characters.
reversals.insufficient: Stripe couldn't take it back: the helper's balance doesn't cover it. It's recorded; recover the money by hand.
reversals.notAllowed: Only finance can take money back, and only from a transfer that has money left.
